title: Orchestrated VPC runtime upgrade with binary-bisection rollback and state synchronizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Automate safe, zero-downtime upgrades for the private data-plane runtime in VPC deployments. Introduce a coordinator that runs a staged rollout, performs binary-bisection rollback on failures, and ensures state (KV cache and session metadata) is synchronized between old and new runtime generations. Integrate preflight Terraform checks, operator lifecycle hooks, and guardrail health probes before traffic shifts.
rollout_plan: Preflight: run terraform plan checks against module 'infra/vpc/runtime' and validate TF variables and provider versions.
Canary stage: deploy small canary slice (5% traffic) to new runtime generation with traffic mirroring from primary; run synthetic requests and production-like prompt sets.
Priming: perform KV and prefix priming using synthetic warmers and observed recent-prefix heatmap to reduce cold-cache misses.
Quorum health gating: require 3 consecutive health probe windows to pass (latency P95, error rate, successful KV ops) before advancing.
Gradual widen: expand in geometric steps (5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%) with automated wait windows and automatic abort on threshold breaches.

Binary-bisection rollback: if a wide-stage failure is detected, perform targeted rollback that bisects tenant slices / node groups to identify the minimal failing slice and revert only affected tenants while keeping healthy slices on new runtime when safe.
State sync: use streaming replication for ephemeral session metadata and KV delta replay to avoid data loss during partial rollbacks.
Post-upgrade validation: run end-to-end evals tied to PRD prompt sets and mark release as complete only after stability window (72 hours) and no quality regressions.
Operator cleanup: garbage collect old runtime images and free snapshot resources after configurable retention.
Observability: emit rollout events to console, annotate traces, and create automated rollback incident if SLOs breach for >10 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Automated terraform preflight fails if TF resources would cause config drift or provider mismatches.
Canary stage must show KV hit-rate >= 85% within priming window and P95 latency within 1.3x baseline for 3 consecutive windows.
Bisection rollback can revert a specific tenant slice idempotently without disrupting other tenant traffic.
No customer-visible errors for tenants outside the failing slice during rollback exercise (to be verified via canary customers).
Operator exposes rollback reason in console and generates an incident for postmortem tracing.
Runbook steps for manual intervention validated by oncall during simulated failure drill.
k8s_operator_hooks: preUpgradeHook: run synthetic-prober job and wait for success
postUpgradeHook: trigger kv-sync-controller to replicate delta window
canaryProbeHook: enable traffic mirror and run canary-eval task
rollbackHook: execute controlled-bisect revert plan and emit events

2026-02-27 - Marco Ruiz: Spike complete. Proof-of-concept bisection rollback implemented in operator simulator. Local tests show rollback isolates failing tenant slice within 2 steps for 64-node topology.

2026-03-03 - SRE review (Liu Chen): Added requirement for quorum health gating and jittered probe windows to avoid correlated false positives. Suggested increasing priming window for high-churn tenants.
2026-03-07 - PM feedback (Rashmi Kapoor): Add acceptance criteria for customer-visible quality regressions using PRD prompt sets. Requested link to quality-evals dashboard.
2026-03-10 - Security (Nate O'Connell): Approved TF module scanning and KMS integration. Noted that operator must not log plaintext session tokens during priming.
2026-03-12 - Marco Ruiz: Deployed canary to staging VPC. Observed KV cold-miss spike at first expansion; priming script reduced spike by 62%. Captured artifacts in Drive link.

2026-03-14 - Aisha Patel: Flagging coordinated drill for 2026-03-22 with SRE and Oncall to validate rollback runbook and monitor playbooks. Preparing customer communication template for potentially affected tenants.
QA Checklist: create staging run that intentionally fails model compatibility check to exercise binary-bisection rollback; validate logs, metrics, and console annotations.
notes: This ticket differs from previous rollouts by providing a deterministic bisection rollback that aims to keep the majority of tenants on the new runtime while surgically reverting only impacted slices. The state synchronizer is critical for safe partial rollbacks to avoid session loss. Terraform preflight will be executed in a dry-run CI pipeline and gated by a human approval for private deploys.
